scenario: asking for help with shopping & payments
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Shopping and Payments
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: shopping & payments — asking for help with shopping & payments
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with shopping & payments; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr David to help her find olive oil.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh David giúp tìm dầu ô liu.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, David. Can you help me find some olive oil?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh David. Anh giúp tôi tìm dầu ô liu được không?

turns.speaker: Mr David
turns.english: Yes, it is in aisle three.
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, nó ở lối đi số ba.
